tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft People
tweaks.description: Removes the standalone People contacts app for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes an optional contacts surface and its package footprint.
tweaks.tradeoff: People-based contact shortcuts require restoring the app.

tweaks.name: Remove Windows Tips
tweaks.description: Removes the Windows Tips and Get Started app for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes onboarding tips and promotional help content.
tweaks.tradeoff: Built-in Windows tips will be unavailable until restored.

tweaks.name: Remove Windows Maps
tweaks.description: Removes the offline-capable Windows Maps app for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes an optional mapping app and downloaded-map integration.
tweaks.tradeoff: Offline maps and apps that hand off to Windows Maps will no longer work.

tweaks.name: Remove Sound Recorder
tweaks.description: Removes the Windows Sound Recorder app for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the inbox audio recorder when it is unused.
tweaks.tradeoff: Recording through Sound Recorder requires reinstalling it.

tweaks.name: Remove Media Player
tweaks.description: Removes the Microsoft Media Player package for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes an optional music and local-media player.
tweaks.tradeoff: Music and media associations must be moved to another player first.

tweaks.name: Remove Movies & TV
tweaks.description: Removes the Movies & TV package for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes an optional video player and storefront surface.
tweaks.tradeoff: Video associations and purchased-content playback need another app or a restore.

tweaks.name: Remove Phone Link
tweaks.description: Removes Phone Link for the current user when phone-to-PC integration is unused.
tweaks.impact: Removes the phone companion app and its user-level background integration.
tweaks.tradeoff: Calls, messages, notifications, and photo sync with a phone stop working.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft To Do
tweaks.description: Removes Microsoft To Do for the current Windows user.
tweaks.tradeoff: Local access and notifications for To Do require reinstalling it.

tweaks.name: Remove Skype
tweaks.description: Removes the Store-delivered Skype client for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes an optional communications app and its startup integration.
tweaks.tradeoff: Skype calling and messaging require the web client or reinstalling the app.

tweaks.name: Remove Teams Personal
tweaks.description: Removes the personal Microsoft Teams package for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes an optional chat client and its user-level background presence.
tweaks.tradeoff: Personal Teams chat, calls, and notifications require reinstalling it.

tweaks.name: Remove new Microsoft Teams
tweaks.description: Removes the new Store-packaged Microsoft Teams client for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the installed Teams client when another collaboration tool is used.
tweaks.tradeoff: Work or school Teams access requires the web client or reinstalling the app.

tweaks.name: Remove Xbox app
tweaks.description: Removes the Xbox app for the current user while leaving Windows gaming services alone.
tweaks.impact: Removes the Xbox library and Game Pass storefront client.
tweaks.tradeoff: Game Pass installation and Xbox library management require restoring the app.

tweaks.name: Remove Xbox Game Bar
tweaks.description: Removes the Xbox Game Bar overlay package for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the Win+G overlay, widgets, capture UI, and social surface.
tweaks.tradeoff: Game Bar capture, performance widgets, party chat, and Win+G stop working.

tweaks.name: Remove Xbox Console Companion
tweaks.description: Removes the retired Xbox Console Companion package for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes a legacy Xbox companion client.
tweaks.tradeoff: Legacy console companion features will be unavailable.

tweaks.name: Remove new Outlook
tweaks.description: Removes the new Outlook for Windows package for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the bundled mail client when another client or webmail is used.
tweaks.tradeoff: Mail and calendar links may need a new default app; local Outlook access stops.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft Copilot app
tweaks.description: Removes the standalone Microsoft Copilot package for the current user where present.
tweaks.impact: Removes the Copilot app and its Start menu entry.
tweaks.tradeoff: Copilot requires the web experience or reinstalling the app.
